spans.s: भृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Borne, carried; 2. supported, maintained; 3. hired, employed for wages; 4. endowed with; 5. full of.
भृत (II) m. A hired servant, (उत्तमस्त्वायुधीयो यो मध्यमस्तु कृषीवलः । अधमो भारवाही स्यादित्येवं त्रिविधो भृतः Mit.).
भृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Borne, carried; 2. supported, maintained; 3. hired, employed for wages; 4. endowed with; 5. full of.
भृतक (I) a. (f. का) Hired.
भृतक (II) m. A hired servant.
भृतक (I) a. (f. का) Hired.
भृतक-अध्यापक m. a hired teacher.
भृतक-अध्यापित m. a paying student, भृतकाध्यापको यश्च भृतकाध्यापितस्तथा M.iii.156.
भृति f. 1. Bearing, supporting; 2. maintaining, nourishing; 3. nourishment, support; 4. service for wages; 5. wages, M.xi.62; 6. principal, capital.
भृति-अध्यापन n. instructing (especially in the Vedas) for wages.
भृति-भुज् m. a hired servant.
भृति-रूप n. a reward given in lieu of wages.
भृत्य m. 1. A servant, R.xi.49; 2. one requiring maintenance; 3. a minister.
भृत्या f. 1. Rearing, nourishing, fostering, कुमारभृत्याकुशलैरनुष्ठिते भिषग्भराप्तैरथ गर्भभर्मणि R.iii.12; 2. maintenance, sustenance; 3. service; 4. wages.
भृत्य-जन m. 1. dependent; 2. the servants (collectively).
भृत्य-वर्ग m. the servants (collectively).
भृत्य-वात्सल्य n. kindness to servants or dependents.
भृत्य-वृत्ति n. maintenance of servants or dependents.
भृत्रिम a. (f. मा) Nourished, maintained, supported.
भृत्रिम a. (f. मा) Nourished, maintained, supported.
